# Dia Browser Security — captured 2026-07-04

Security as product feature: independent audits/pen-testing (annual, findings in Security Bulletins), Chromium engine, minimized data collection.

Agent/automation safeguards (8 core controls vs prompt injection): blocks auto-opening of AI-generated URLs; explicit user approval before tool access; content preview before insert into third-party sites; actions stay draft until user confirms; agent restricted to user-approved context only; agent prevented from navigating to unapproved sites; sensitive form fields hidden from agent; URL filtering to prevent instruction injection. Docs acknowledge residual risk (style shifts, misinformation nudges, unintended searches).

Data: local-first storage default, E2E encryption for synced data, AI partners contractually barred from training, no data selling, default ad-blocker.
Compliance: SOC 2 Type II (CY2025 audit, 2026 report); critical Chromium patches <48h; weekly releases.

## Last Fetched
2026-07-04 — Security page covers existing agentic safeguards (approval gates, exfil blocking, URL sanitization). No new dated announcement. Unchanged from prior.
